info.title: DotEnvUp
info.description: DotEnvUp is distributed as npm packages, a VS Code/Cursor extension, and a local stdio MCP server (@dotenvup/mcp). There is no hosted REST API on dotenvup.com; this document describes discoverable surfaces and install entrypoints for automation.

get.description: HTML homepage. A Markdown-oriented summary is linked with rel=alternate from the HTML document and served at /markdown.md.
